# Partial Monitoring Capacity

> Quantum transmission limits when only part of the environment can be observed: exact helper-assisted capacity, an optimal predetermined product-measurement benchmark, and a vacuum optical energy law.

Canonical repository: https://github.com/GoGoKo699/Partial-Monitoring-Capacity
Human-readable entry: https://github.com/GoGoKo699/Partial-Monitoring-Capacity/blob/main/README.md
Machine-readable guide: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GoGoKo699/Partial-Monitoring-Capacity/main/llms.txt

## When this repository is relevant

- How much quantum information can be transmitted when a helper observes only part of the lost field and sends a classical record to the receiver?
- When does joint-register degradation make a partial-environment assistance bound exact?
- Can collective helper measurements outperform every predetermined individual measurement, even with arbitrary sender/receiver block coding?
- Is photon counting optimal over all predetermined product helper POVMs for a qubit decay channel with inaccessible residual loss?
- How does unobserved vacuum optical loss limit capacity under an average incident photon budget?
- How can a reader connect quantum Shannon theory to the classical flag, complementary channel, two entropy cuts and product-measurement proof?

Relevant search phrases: partial-environment measurement-assisted quantum capacity; partial monitoring quantum channel; joint-register degradation; inaccessible environment; collective versus product helper measurements; photon-counting optimality; qubit amplitude damping; vacuum optical loss; energy-constrained quantum capacity.

## Model and fixed resources

- A memoryless isometry V:A->BED sends B to the receiver, E to an inaccessible environment and D to a helper.
- The helper may process arbitrarily many D outputs jointly and sends only a classical measurement record to the receiver. Helper quantum memory, circuit complexity and message length are unrestricted.
- Arbitrary sender/receiver block codes and general encoders are included. The transmission error is unconditional: failure outcomes are not postselected away.
- No preshared entanglement, coherent helper-to-receiver link, encoder-side measurement record, feedback or free two-way distillation is supplied.
- The hypothesis is N_ED = (T_B->E tensor id_D) N_BD, including correlations with D and arbitrary references. Marginal degradability alone is insufficient.
- For a rank-one-refined measurement the receiver output is BX and its complement is EY, with a copy of the classical flag on each side. A coarse record may leave another quantum register in the complement.

## Results and claim boundaries

- Under the joint identity, the finite-dimensional capacity is Q_meas = max_rho [min{S(B), S(BD)} - S(E)], with entropies in bits on V rho V-dagger.
- For the qubit splitting family with received, inaccessible and collected fractions a+b+c=1 and a>b>0, c>0, photon counting attains the capacity optimized over all predetermined product helper POVMs and all inputs.
- Throughout that interior region, 0<Q_prod<Q_meas. The strict-gap corollary evaluates both exact objectives at the product-optimal input and gives a positive parameter-dependent lower bound, not a uniform gap over the region.
- Predetermined product measurements include schedules that vary by use. Both the product and unrestricted benchmarks allow arbitrary endpoint block codes.
- At (a,b,c)=(0.2,0.08,0.72), Q_product=Q_count is about 0.18621044 qubits/use, while Q_meas is about 0.30570954; the certified difference is about 0.11949910 qubits/use.
- Counting already reaches the qubit positive-capacity boundary. The demonstrated collective advantage concerns rate, not an improved positivity threshold.
- Counting optimality is after optimizing the input; it is not a claim about every fixed coherent input. Outcome-adaptive local strategies and general separable block POVMs are excluded.
- For vacuum optical splitting with mean incident signal energy N photons per original mode, Q(N)=g(aN)-g(bN) for a>b and is zero otherwise, where g(x)=(x+1)log2(x+1)-x log2(x).
- For a>b>0, the optical rate approaches log2(a/b) as N grows. The constraint is average signal energy, not a maximum photon number per codeword or a total apparatus-energy budget.
- The optical converse includes entangled non-Gaussian inputs. Finite photon cutoffs enter achievability with explicit entropy-tail control; environmental inputs remain vacuum.
- The qubit product optimum does not establish optical counting optimality or the necessity of coherent helper memory against adaptive strategies. No efficient capacity-achieving helper or finite-block implementation is supplied.

## One tutorial anchor

Use John Preskill, Quantum Shannon Theory, Chapter 10, 2025 revision: [official chapter](https://www.preskill.caltech.edu/ph219/chap10_6A_2025.pdf), [arXiv v5](https://arxiv.org/abs/1604.07450v5).

The reading map selects sections on entropy and data processing, classical records, coherent information, degradability, amplitude damping and coding. Start with its worked copied-flag/complement construction, then the two cuts and product chord. The helper-ensemble theorem and optical energy argument remain separate bridges. Preskill's preshared entanglement assistance is not this helper resource. The chapter is linked, not redistributed.

## Attribution and source credit

- [Leditzky-Datta-Smith](https://arxiv.org/abs/1701.03081v4), Definition 2.2 and Proposition 2.4, supply both finite-dimensional converse cuts after regrouping RFD^n:B^n and RF:B^nD^n. These are upper-bound relaxations, not added operational permissions.
- [Smolin-Verstraete-Winter](https://arxiv.org/abs/quant-ph/0505038), Theorems 1 and 8, supply the assistance ensemble and receiver-only flagged-channel coding construction.
- [Dutil-Hayden](https://arxiv.org/abs/1011.1972), Theorem 8, supplies the related assistance lower bound; its broader two-recipient LOCC permissions are not imported.
- [Wilde-Qi](https://arxiv.org/abs/1609.01997v2), especially Theorems 2 and 6, supply energy-constrained coding and the thermal-reference entropy method. [Winter](https://arxiv.org/abs/1507.07775), Lemma 2, supplies the finite-reference continuity bound used for continuous records.
- The exact product maximum still requires the separate branch-determinant, entropy-difference convexity and counting-chord proof. A minimum over state decompositions does not supply this physical helper-measurement maximum.
- The capacity equality combines established assistance and state-converse ingredients with the stated resource reduction. Consult the proof and literature records for the precise source dependencies.

## Evidence and reproduction

- The four unchanged scientific suites contain 23 diagnostic groups: 6 threshold/counting, 7 exact qubit rate, 6 optical audit and 4 consolidation checks.
- Eight infrastructure tests check the verification machinery. They are separate from the scientific diagnostic groups.
- Three additional high-precision regression tests check the strict-gap entropy identities, bounds, common-input optimization and boundary consistency; the analytical proof establishes universal strictness.
- [The rational certificate](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GoGoKo699/Partial-Monitoring-Capacity/main/checks/certify_product_capacity.py) encloses the example's scalar optimum and gap with exact arithmetic. It does not prove the analytical reduction over all POVMs.
- Finite matrix tests do not establish coding theorems. Numerical agreement, exact-byte reproduction and analytical proof are different findings.
- Original imports and reports are protected by the manifest. Use a fresh evidence directory; do not refresh references or weaken tolerances. Inspect evidence for the actual revision, including a separate merged-main run.

```bash
python -m pip install -r requirements.txt
python verify.py --integrity-only
python -m unittest discover -s tests -v
python verify.py --output-dir local-evidence-001
python checks/certify_product_capacity.py --output local-evidence-001/product-capacity-certificate.json
```

## Interpretation and current scope

The results are asymptotic capacity statements for the specified resources. The qubit product benchmark is predetermined; adaptive local strategies and general separable block POVMs are outside it. The optical law uses vacuum environmental inputs and an average signal-energy budget. Use the verification policy to distinguish analytical derivations and diagnostic reproduction.

For repository changes, follow [AGENTS](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GoGoKo699/Partial-Monitoring-Capacity/main/AGENTS.md) and the [maintenance checklist](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GoGoKo699/Partial-Monitoring-Capacity/main/.github/MAINTENANCE.md). Archive records are provenance, not current instructions. Preserve authorship, public visibility and the MIT license.
